bio.summary: Undergraduate Computer Science student at NED University and an active hands-on Software Engineer specializing in Web3 Smart Contracts, Applied Machine Learning, and Full-Stack Engineering. As an active technical builder and consultant, I bridge the gap between blockchain trustlessness and intelligent AI agent workflows.

bio.aiFocus: Developing agentic LLM workflows and data-driven pipelines. Experienced in orchestrating multi-agent research evaluation systems, predictive student engagement modeling (SEPICP), and computer vision pipelines (OpenCV, YOLOv8).
bio.fullStackFocus: Engineering resilient, modular web applications using React 19, Next.js, Node.js, Django REST Framework, TypeScript, Oracle XE, and Supabase.
